lines.zh: 我在雪林上空一高一低地飞。
lines.en: I fly over the snowy wood, dipping and rising.
There is snow dust on my wings.
I skim past the pine boughs.

lines.zh: 我在圣诞树下绕了一圈。
lines.en: I circle a Christmas tree.

lines.zh: 我的小红鼻子在雪里很显眼。
lines.en: My little red nose stands out in the snow.

lines.zh: 我一扇翅，雪就从树上落下。
lines.en: One wingbeat and snow falls from the tree.
I keep low; the wind is strong.

lines.zh: 我停在一根挂彩带的枝上。
lines.en: I perch on a ribboned branch.

lines.zh: 我的影子在雪地上滑过。
lines.en: My shadow glides over the snow.
I fly out from under the eaves.

lines.zh: 雪落在我背上，很快化了。
lines.en: Snow lands on my back and melts.
I fly along the chimney smoke.

lines.zh: 我一次又一次地绕回来。
lines.en: I circle back again and again.
I drop slowly above the bushes.

lines.zh: 我在雪堆之间穿来穿去。
lines.en: I weave between the snowdrifts.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀在冷空气里发涩。
lines.en: My wings stiffen in the cold air.
I hang upside down under the eaves.
My nose tip glows from the cold.
The snow keeps falling.
I listen to the bells.
I beat my wings once, slowly.

lines.zh: 彩灯在我旁边一闪一闪。
lines.en: The lights blink beside me.

lines.zh: 这一夜我什么也没抓到。
lines.en: I have caught nothing this night.
I wrap my wings around myself.
The night is long here.
My nose twitches.
I wait for the snow to ease.
It is warmer under the eaves.
Are you offering me a carrot?
Your breath looks fine in the cold.
Your hat is covered in snow.

lines.zh: 我鼻子红，可我不是驯鹿。
lines.en: My nose is red, but I am not a reindeer.
Don't wave; I will fly off.
The wood is quiet this season.
I hear steps clearly on snow.

lines.zh: 鼻子红归红，我可不会拉雪橇。
lines.en: Red nose or not, I'm not pulling any sleigh.
I flinch and swing on the branch.

lines.zh: 我的红鼻子撞在树枝上。
lines.en: My red nose smacks into a branch.
Snow falls from the tree.
I squeak and hang on the branch.
I move to the far side of the branch.
It hurts, but I can still fly.
My nose is rubbed red.

lines.zh: 这一下让我掉了几根毛。
lines.en: That cost me a few hairs.
Snow shakes off my wings.
This body cannot take a beating.
I want that sweet thing.

lines.zh: 我朝那边扇了两下翅膀。
lines.en: I beat toward it twice.
Higher; I cannot reach.
Are these berries?

lines.zh: 那根拐杖糖的甜味，我啄一下。
lines.en: That candy cane's sweetness; I peck at it once.
Do you have more? I am hungry.
I will fly back to the eaves after this.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起暖的地方。
lines.en: This taste reminds me of somewhere warm.
You bumped the branch I hang from.

lines.zh: 我一下飞起来，雪都落了。
lines.en: I fly up and the snow falls.
That tangled the ribbon.
A bat cannot hurt a person.

lines.zh: 我在你帽子边上绕了一圈。
lines.en: I circle your hat once.
We kick up a cloud of snow.
I hang back in place.

lines.zh: 你的肩擦到了我的翅膀。
lines.en: Your shoulder brushed my wing.
Do not shake that tree.
Fine; I will move elsewhere.
There are few of my kind in this snowy wood.
I need food first.
The snow has not stopped; not this.
I tilt my head and my nose twitches.
That has nothing to do with bells.
I tuck myself into my wings.
Ask when the snow melts.
I fly to a higher branch.
Right now I only want warmth.
I take it in my teeth.
It is a little heavier than I am.
I fly to a branch to eat it slowly.
It is frozen wood.

lines.zh: 圣诞森林的风，带着糖味。
lines.en: Christmas forest wind smells of candy.
It fell in the snow; I dig it out.
I bite it; it is snow.
I drop it on the snow.
Good; kept under my wing.
A shadow moves on the snow.

lines.zh: 我的红鼻子朝那边转了。
lines.en: My red nose turns that way.
Nose twitching. Sniffing snow.
That does not look like prey.
I fly out from the eaves.
I go behind the tree to look.

lines.zh: 彩灯把这一带照得很亮。
lines.en: The lights make this area bright.
I dislike brightness.

lines.zh: 红鼻子在雪里嗅了两下。
lines.en: My red nose sniffs twice in the snow.
I am paying attention now.
I follow it over the snowy wood.

lines.zh: 它每走一步都留下深脚印。
lines.en: Every step leaves a deep print.
I land on a low branch and wait.
Snow falls on me and I do not move.

lines.zh: 彩灯下我的影子挪到它脚边。
lines.en: Under the fairy lights, my shadow slides to its feet.
I slip down from the tree.
My shadow is beside it.
It has not looked overhead.
I circle half way through the snowy branches.
It starts walking; I follow.

lines.zh: 我扑到它肩上咬了一口。
lines.en: I dive at its shoulder and bite.
It swipes and I fly clear.
I land behind it again.
I beat my snowy wings at it.
It backs a step into the tree.

lines.zh: 圣诞森林的铃声，我听见。
lines.en: I hear the Christmas forest bells.
Snow scatters from my wings.

lines.zh: 我又在它耳后咬了一下。
lines.en: I bite behind its ear again.
It goes; I hang in the tree and pant.
I settle on a snowy branch.
This is the Christmas forest.
My nose lights first.
The snow is deep and soundless.
Lights blink in the far trees.
First I tidy my wings.
So cold; I should find some eaves.
Bells are ringing in the trees.
My kind are not here.
Good; a quick flight to look around.
Fire curls my wings.

lines.zh: 我从空中落进雪里，很深。
lines.en: I drop from the air into deep snow.

lines.zh: 冷水浸透我，我飞不起来。
lines.en: Cold water soaks me and I cannot fly.
The blast throws me into a drift.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我翅膀发麻。
lines.en: That force numbs my wings.

lines.zh: 雪下什么都没有，我饿了。
lines.en: Nothing under the snow; I am hungry.
The flash bleaches the snow white.
I fall, wings beating nothing.
